rows.source_ko: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this ruleis to prescribe matters delegated by the Art Promotion Act and the Enforcement Decree of the Art Promotion Act , and matters necessary for the implementation thereof.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Art Promotion Act and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, and matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: Article 2 (Reporting of Art Service Business, etc.) ① The report and change report for art service business pursuant to Article 10-2, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree of the Art Promotion Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”)shall be in accordance with Form No. 1 of the attached document.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Reporting of Art Service Business, etc.) ① The report and change report for an art service business pursuant to Article 10-2(1) of the Enforcement Decree of the Art Promotion Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) shall be in accordance with Form No. 1 of the Attached Form.

rows.source_ko: ② In the latter part of Article 18, Paragraph 1 of the “Arts Promotion Act” (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”), “important matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism” refers to the matters under Subparagraphs 1 through 4 of Article 10-2, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree .
rows.text_en: ② In the latter part of Article 18(1) of the Art Promotion Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”), “important matters prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism” refers to the matters under subparagraphs 1 through 4 of Article 10-2(1) of the Enforcement Decree.

rows.source_ko: ③ In Article 18 , Paragraph 3 of the Act , “notification certificate prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism” refers to the art service business notification certificate in Form No. 2 of the Appendix.
rows.text_en: ③ In Article 18 , Paragraph 3 of the Act , “notification certificate prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism” refers to the art service business notification certificate in Form No. 2 of the Appendix.

rows.source_ko: ④ In cases where a person who has been issued a certificate of registration pursuant to Article 18, Paragraph 3 of the Act loses the certificate or the certificate becomes worn out and unusable and wishes to have it reissued, they must submit an application for reissuance of the art service business registration certificate in the form of Annex 3, along with documents classified according to the following subparagraphs, to the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City or the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province (referring to the Mayor, County Head, or District Head in cases where there are local government entities such as cities, counties, or districts within the jurisdiction of the Special Self-Governing Province), the Mayor, County Head, or District Head (referring to the District Head of an autonomous district).
rows.text_en: ④ In cases where a person who has been issued a certificate of registration pursuant to Article 18, Paragraph 3 of the Act loses the certificate or the certificate becomes worn out and unusable and wishes to have it reissued, they must submit an application for reissuance of the art service business registration certificate in the form of Annex 3, along with documents classified according to the following subparagraphs, to the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City or the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province (referring to the Mayor, County Head, or District Head in cases where there are local government entities such as cities, counties, or districts within the jurisdiction of the Special Self-Governing Province), the Mayor, County Head, or District Head (referring to the District Head of an autonomous district).

rows.source_ko: 1. In case of loss of report: Statement of reason for loss
rows.text_en: 1. In case of loss of report: Statement of reason for loss

rows.source_ko: 2. In the case where the registration certificate is worn out and unusable: that registration certificate
rows.text_en: 2. In the case where the registration certificate is worn out and unusable: that registration certificate

rows.source_ko: Article 3 (Notification of Business Closure) In Article 10, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “notification form prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism” refers to the notification of business closure for art service businesses in Form No. 4 of the Appendix.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Notification of Business Closure) In Article 10, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “notification form prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism” refers to the notification of business closure for art service businesses in Form No. 4 of the Appendix.

rows.source_ko: Article 4 (Succession of Business) In Article 10-5, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “report form prescribed by the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism” refers to the report form for the succession of status of art service business in Annex 5.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Succession of Business) In Article 10-5, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “report form prescribed by the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism” refers to the report form for the succession of status of art service business in Annex 5.
